# Example output

An abbreviated region generated from the stock MarkitUI file (one brand, Custom typography, shadcn project). `/* … */` marks lines left out of this example; a real run writes every token. Use it as the target shape; the values must always come from the live file.

```css
/* markitui:tokens:start · generated by markitui-import-variables, do not edit by hand */
/* source: MarkitUI (<fileKey>) · synced: 2026-11-18 · typography: custom · brands: brand-a (default) */

@theme static {
  /* Palettes (Tailwind CSS collection) */
  --color-white: #ffffff;
  --color-black: #000000;
  --color-neutral-50: #fafafa;
  /* … neutral-100 … neutral-950 */
  --color-brand-50: #faf5ff;
  /* … */
  --color-brand-500: #ad46ff;
  --color-brand-600: #9810fa;
  --color-brand-700: #8200db;
  /* … brand-950, red, green, yellow, blue */

  --spacing: 0.25rem;

  /* Fonts (Theme) */
  --font-sans: "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-serif: "Playfair Display", ui-serif, Georgia, serif;
  --font-mono: "Roboto Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
  --font-weight-thin: 100;
  /* … */
  --font-weight-semibold: 600;
  --font-weight-bold: 700;
  /* … */

  /* Tailwind text scale (Theme text/*) */
  --text-xs: 0.75rem;
  --text-xs--line-height: 1rem;
  --text-base: 1rem;
  --text-base--line-height: 1.5rem;
  /* … through text-9xl */

  /* Radius */
  --radius-xs: 0.125rem;
  /* … */
  --radius-4xl: 2rem;
  --radius-main: 0; /* radius-main: a number (e.g. 10 → 0.625rem) or an alias (e.g. rounded-lg → var(--radius-lg)) */

  /* Breakpoints and containers */
  --breakpoint-md: 48rem;
  --breakpoint-xl: 80rem;
  /* … */
  --container-7xl: 80rem;
  /* … */

  /* Blur and shadows */
  --blur-md: 12px;
  /* … */
  --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
  /* … through shadow-2xl */

  /* Semantic colours: Brand A / Light */
  --color-bg-primary: var(--color-white);
  --color-bg-secondary: var(--color-neutral-50);
  --color-bg-accent: var(--color-brand-500);
  --color-bg-overlay: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-black) 30%, transparent);
  --color-bg-transparent: transparent;
  --color-fg-primary: var(--color-black);
  --color-fg-secondary: var(--color-neutral-500);
  --color-interactive-primary: var(--color-black);
  --color-interactive-primary-hover: var(--color-neutral-900);
  --color-interactive-accent: var(--color-brand-500);
  --color-border-subtle: var(--color-neutral-200);
  --color-focus-ring-default: var(--color-black);
  --color-focus-ring-destructive: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-red-500) 30%, transparent);
  --color-focus-ring-inner: var(--color-bg-primary);
  /* … every other semantic colour */
}

@theme inline {
  --shadow-focus-ring-default: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-focus-ring-inner), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-focus-ring-default);
  --shadow-focus-ring-destructive: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-focus-ring-inner), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-focus-ring-destructive);
  --shadow-focus-ring-hover: 0 0 0 4px var(--color-interactive-secondary-hover);
}

/* Semantic colours: Brand A / Dark (every token repeated) */
.dark {
  --color-bg-primary: var(--color-neutral-900);
  --color-bg-secondary: var(--color-neutral-800);
  --color-bg-accent: var(--color-brand-500);
  --color-fg-primary: var(--color-neutral-100);
  --color-interactive-primary: var(--color-white);
  --color-focus-ring-default: var(--color-white);
  --color-focus-ring-inner: var(--color-bg-primary);
  /* … every other semantic colour */

  /* shadcn bridge */
  --background: var(--color-bg-primary);
  --foreground: var(--color-fg-primary);
  --primary: var(--color-interactive-primary);
  --primary-foreground: var(--color-fg-on-primary);
  --accent: var(--color-interactive-secondary-hover);
  --ring: var(--color-focus-ring-default);
  /* … rest of the bridge */
}

:root {
  /* shadcn bridge */
  --background: var(--color-bg-primary);
  --foreground: var(--color-fg-primary);
  --primary: var(--color-interactive-primary);
  --primary-foreground: var(--color-fg-on-primary);
  --accent: var(--color-interactive-secondary-hover);
  --ring: var(--color-focus-ring-default);
  --radius: var(--radius-main);
  /* … rest of the bridge */

  /* Custom: layout (base) */
  --grid-column-count: 12;
  --grid-gutter: calc(var(--spacing) * 3);
  --container-max-width: var(--container-7xl);
  --container-padding-x: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
  --section-padding-y: calc(var(--spacing) * 12);
  --card-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
  --panel-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 6);
  /* … */

  /* Custom: typography (base) */
  --headline-font-family: var(--font-sans);
  --headline-font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  --fontsize-headline-xl: 2.25rem;
  --lineheight-headline-xl: 2.25rem;
  --body-font-family: var(--font-sans);
  --body-font-weight-medium: var(--font-weight-medium);
  --fontsize-body-md: 1rem;
  --lineheight-body-md: 1.5rem;
  /* … */

  @media (width >= 48rem) {
    --container-padding-x: calc(var(--spacing) * 5);
    --section-padding-y: calc(var(--spacing) * 16);
    --card-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 6);
    --panel-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 8);
    --fontsize-headline-xl: 2.5rem;
    --lineheight-headline-xl: 2.5rem;
    /* … only values that differ from base */
  }

  @media (width >= 80rem) {
    --grid-gutter: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    --container-padding-x: calc(var(--spacing) * 6);
    --panel-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 10);
    --fontsize-headline-xl: 3rem;
    --lineheight-headline-xl: 3rem;
    /* … only values that differ from md */
  }
}

@utility type-headline-xl {
  font-family: var(--headline-font-family);
  font-weight: var(--headline-font-weight);
  font-size: var(--fontsize-headline-xl);
  line-height: var(--lineheight-headline-xl);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

@utility type-body-md-link {
  font-family: var(--body-font-family);
  font-weight: var(--body-font-weight-medium);
  font-size: var(--fontsize-body-md);
  line-height: var(--lineheight-body-md);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  text-decoration-line: underline;
}

@utility type-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--eyebrow-font-family);
  font-weight: var(--eyebrow-font-weight);
  font-size: var(--fontsize-eyebrow-md);
  line-height: var(--lineheight-eyebrow-md);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
/* … one @utility per Custom text style */

/* markitui:tokens:end */
```

## How the result is used in code

| In Figma | In code |
|---|---|
| Fill `colors/bg-secondary` | `bg-bg-secondary` |
| Text colour `colors/fg-secondary` | `text-fg-secondary` |
| Stroke `colors/border-subtle` | `border-border-subtle` |
| Button fill `colors/interactive-accent` | `bg-interactive-accent hover:bg-interactive-accent-hover` |
| Corner radius `radius-main` | `rounded-main` |
| Effect `drop-shadow/shadow-md` | `shadow-md` |
| Effect `focus-ring/default` | `focus-visible:shadow-focus-ring-default` |
| Padding `layout/section-padding-y` | `py-(--section-padding-y)` |
| Gap `layout/grid-gutter` | `gap-(--grid-gutter)` |
| Text style `Custom/Headline/Headline XL` | `type-headline-xl` |
| Text style `Tailwind CSS/text-2xl/leading-normal/bold` | `text-2xl font-bold` |
